summary: Frontend-only testing of Linesheet page v2 (Tools › Linesheet). All acceptance criteria from the review request pass. Login via empty credentials, sidebar navigation, toolbar (ls-search, ls-season default SS27 with 26 products, ls-filter-collection), season 'all' shows 57 products with pager 'Page 1 of 4' and ls-next advances to page 2. Card click toggles aria-pressed=true and shows selected count (1/120). ls-select-page selects 18 visible (label toggles to 'Deselect visible page'), ls-clear resets to (0/120). Rail: title 'Linesheet' with 9/200 counter. ls-ctx default 'customer' shows ls-customer-list with ls-customer-c1; ls-customer-search 'lids' filters to Lids only. Before customer, picked row shows 'Select customer' and Preview is disabled. After selecting c1 (Mirabile Distribution · #70057 · Distributor), row shows 'Price pending' then resolves to $8.80 (base $16 × 0.55). ls-customer-clear resets. ls-ctx 'list' shows ls-pricelist select. ls-ctx 'generic' resolves to $16.00 (US Wholesale). MSRP/MOQ toggles work. Notes textarea works. ls-remove-<id> present. ls-preview opens ls-preview-page/ls-doc; ls-print & ls-download increment window.print stub (calls 1→2). ls-back returns keeping selection (2/120). ls-print-direct/ls-download-direct open preview and call print (calls 3→4). Layout at 1920x800: grid x=339 w=1122, rail x=1482 w=400, no overlap. 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: priceFor is unit-based only; multiplier applied irrespective of currency for International EUR (1.08x), which is a naive proxy — noted but acceptable for mock.
ls-toggle-msrp/moq use visually-hidden inputs; interact via label click in future tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Linesheet v2 verified. ls-* testids match code. Stub window.print via add_init_script BEFORE navigation. Customer list is searchable ul (ls-customer-list) with ls-customer-<id> buttons; selecting one hides the list and shows ls-customer-selected + ls-customer-clear.
